name: pico
short: An LLM-backed Discord presence that decides whether to react, then acts only via tools
description: Pico watches messages in servers where it's enabled, decides whether a message deserves a reaction, and if so, acts exclusively through a bounded tool-calling loop -- never a raw LLM text send. Iteration 1 ships one tool: replying through corridor.
end_user_data_statement: This cog reads recent Discord message content in servers where it is enabled, and sends that content (plus channel history used as context) to the configured LLM endpoint. It stores per-server enabled state and bot-owner LLM connection settings (including the virtual key) in Red's Config store.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Configure the LLM connection with [p]pico llm endpoint/key/model (bot owner), then enable a guild with [p]pico enabled true.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
